mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS extensionId FROM fcc_extension e WHERE e.extension = #{extension} AND e.endpoint_type = 'SIP' AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id AS extensionId, a.id AS agentId, (SELECT b.id FROM fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b WHERE b.agent_id = a.id AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND b.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1) AS activeBindingId FROM fcc_extension e JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.extension = #{extension} AND e.endpoint_type = 'SIP' AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.id AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND b.is_active = 1 WHERE (a.work_no = #{owner} OR b.endpoint_value = #{extension}) AND (p.active_call_id IS NOT NULL OR p.work_status = 'ACW')
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = b.agent_id SET b.status = 'DISABLED', b.is_active = 0, b.valid_to = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE b.endpoint_type = 'SIP' AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND (a.work_no = #{owner} OR b.endpoint_value = #{extension})
UPDATE fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = b.agent_id SET b.is_active = 0 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND b.is_active = 1

UPDATE fcc_extension e JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL SET e.agent_work_no = a.work_no, e.agent_name = a.agent_name WHERE e.extension = #{extension} AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_agent_endpoint_selection_audit( id, agent_id, actor, old_binding_id, new_binding_id, result, created_at ) SELECT #{id}, a.id, CONCAT('SIP:', #{owner}), #{oldBindingId}, #{newBindingId}, 'SUCCESS', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM fcc_agent a WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
